layout.title: Muyenga Residential Project
layout.intro_description: This two-storey residence in Muyenga combines a grand columned entrance, arched openings and balconies with a paved compound. Snow Holdings delivered the construction and finishing works to create a home built for comfort and durability.
layout.approach_description: We worked through the structure, walling and roofing, then focused on the details that define the home: the columns, arches, balconies and external finishes. The compound was completed with paving to finish the property.

goals_items.title: Quality finishing
goals_items.description: — careful workmanship on the features that give the home its character.

layout.conclusion_description: The Muyenga project is one of the homes featured in our portfolio, showing the level of finish Snow Holdings brings to residential construction.
